instrumentation_rule: Only this exact PID, start_ticks, executable and cgroup identity; no process-name, descendant or other Codex exemption. CPU recorded separately on the same CPU-window anchors.
host_steal_policy: record only; physical host runs active Kubernetes workloads and host exclusivity is not claimed
other_vm_gates: Unchanged: unknown VM CPU >=0.25 core per PID or >=0.5 core aggregate, swap >=256 pages/s, recognized-heavy-process vetoes, active/queued leases, Lean tickets, sockets, disk and monitor gaps.
prior_campaign_disposition: Preserved, superseded for comparison; no retained timings carried forward. Rerun all six axes under this policy with the same benchmark binary.
